name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
summary: At Zoram'gar, the Horde moves against the Twilight's Hammer cult in Blackfathom Deeps. Je'neu Sancrea sends champions after Lorgus Jett to disrupt the cultists who seek to awaken ancient forces of destruction beneath Ashenvale's coast.

sections.title: The Threat Beneath Zoram'gar
sections.body: Zoram'gar Outpost watches Blackfathom Deeps from the Ashenvale shore. Naga, corrupted beasts, and Twilight's Hammer fanatics overrun the submerged temple complex. Je'neu Sancrea, an Earthen Ring seer stationed on the coast, sees that the cultists serve the Old Gods rather than the land's natural balance and spirits. These monstrous beings of chaos were defeated in ancient times, yet their malign touch still lingers in Azeroth's forgotten places.

sections.title: Ending Lorgus Jett
sections.body: Je'neu sends Horde champions into the underground ruins to hunt Lorgus Jett, a key leader among the cultists established in Blackfathom Deeps. Lorgus works deep in the stone passages between the chambers of Ghamoo-ra, the giant turtle, and Baron Aquanis, the water elemental. Je'neu is too frail to enter the damp darkness himself. Lorgus's defeat is vital to severing the dark rituals he sought to orchestrate beneath Ashenvale's waves.

sections.title: Staving off Chaos
sections.body: Lorgus Jett's death contains the immediate ritual threat to the coast, though Je'neu knows the Twilight's Hammer remains active. Its quiet infiltration of ancient holy sites points to a wider menace seeking the return of the Old Gods. At Zoram'gar, Lorgus's defeat buys the Horde time against an enemy hidden in the world's shadows.

faq.answer: Lorgus Jett is an established leader of the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Blackfathom Deeps. He directs rituals meant to bring back the ancient Old Gods and their rule.

faq.q: Where can Lorgus Jett be found in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Lorgus Jett patrols Blackfathom Deeps' flooded corridors, in the connecting halls between Ghamoo-ra's chamber and Baron Aquanis's altar area.

aliases: who gives allegiance to the old gods
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea is a Darkspear troll seer of the Earthen Ring, stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. He watches elemental disturbances and the corruption in Blackfathom Deeps.

faq.q: Why does Je'neu care about the Twilight's Hammer?
faq.answer: Je'neu is dedicated to understanding nature and elemental balance, and sees the Twilight's Hammer as an existential threat. The cult serves the chaotic Old Gods, whose return would undo the world's harmony.

The Old Gods are primordial beings of chaos and destruction who ruled Azeroth in the distant past before they were defeated and buried. The Twilight's Hammer worships them and schemes to break their seals, bringing back their destructive rule.

faq.q: Why can't Je'neu Sancrea kill Lorgus Jett himself?
faq.answer: Je'neu is too frail to brave Blackfathom Deeps alone. He tracks spiritual and elemental disturbances from the outpost while Horde champions do the fighting.

angles.text: Defeating Lorgus Jett protects Zoram'gar Outpost and its isolated Horde encampment from insidious cultist plots.
The Twilight's Hammer seeks to unleash elemental fury for the chaotic Old Gods. Eradicating the cult is a priority for those sworn to elemental balance alongside the Earthen Ring.
Helping Je'neu Sancrea honors the wisdom of a respected Darkspear seer working far from the Echo Isles to protect Azeroth's primal spirits.
